Q1.synopsis: Fourteen-year-old orphan Elara learns she is the chosen one and is sent to a hidden magic school. Her rival, a proud prince, slowly becomes her ally as a slow burn romance grows, while a dragon threatens the royal court.

Q2.synopsis: Two sworn enemies from rival houses are forced to share a throne. Amid betrayal & intrigue, a found family of exiles helps them survive, and hatred turns to love.

A.title: The Quiet Detective of Vael
A.synopsis: A retired detective investigates a murder inside a royal court, where every courtier hides a secret and a betrayal waits behind each door.

B.title: Dragon Rider Academy
B.synopsis: A young mage enrolls at an academy for dragon riders, where a rival prince challenges her at every turn. The rivalry softens into a slow burn romance as an ancient dragon wakes beneath the school.

C.title: The Hollow Crown
C.synopsis: Two rival heirs are bound by a treaty marriage and must rule together. Betrayal stalks the royal court, and a found family of exiles gives them a reason to trust each other.

D.title: Chosen of the Storm
D.synopsis: An orphan farm girl is named the chosen one by a prophecy and trains at a school of storm magic. A dragon-hunting prince opposes her, but a slow burn alliance forms.

E.title: Summer of the Island Witch
E.synopsis: A teenage witch spends the summer on a quiet island, befriends a young dragon, and finds a gentle romance that takes its time to bloom.
